source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보 데이터에 반영해줘. 시각 의미 데이터의 대체 표현을 추가/보강하는 작업을 중심으로 진행하고 후보 데이터에도 잘 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 이번에 반영한 주제가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

baseline_prompt_en: A richly detailed magical-world photographic scene of a fictional adult witch-artisan calibrating a potion in a stone laboratory. The supplied reference guides her face and black bob with fine fringe: retain the brown eyes, narrow straight nose, natural pink lip shape and small cheek beauty mark. Seated at a worn stone workbench, she leans a little forward with relaxed shoulders, eyes lowered toward the liquid and lips gently parted in concentration. Her right hand holds one slender tapering wooden wand between thumb and curled fingers; the forearm extends naturally beside the pot, and the wand tip hovers just above the liquid. A small pale-blue glimmer at the tip traces a circular ripple directly beneath it. Her left hand lies palm-down on the bench clear of the hot vessel, its fingers relaxed. The open black cast-iron cauldron has a round belly, a rolled rim, two loop handles on opposite sides and three short feet resting on the stone; blue liquid and a thin rising steam plume are visible within its opening. A freestanding brass temperature dial stands beyond the pot. Her long-sleeved black wizarding robe falls open at the collar, exposing an emerald-green inner facing edged in narrow silver braid. A palm-sized golden pendant rests flat at the centre of her chest: three nested circular rings surround a small upright transparent hourglass with a narrow glass waist and sand in its lower bulb, hanging from one fine chain. A three-quarter waist-up portrait includes her face, both hands and the complete cauldron, photographed from slightly above bench height so the liquid surface is readable. Warm window light caresses her cheek and the gold pendant while the cool potion glow softly touches the wand hand. The face, tip-to-ripple relationship and hourglass are crisp; the stone wall and tall reagent shelves recede gently behind her.
